title: Wasted Time
lyrics_synced:
[00:19.99] Well, baby, there you stand
[00:27.46] with your little head down in your hand.
[00:34.53] Oh my God, you can't believe it's happening again.
[00:42.48] Your baby's gone and you're all alone
[00:46.27] and it looks like the end.
[00:52.60] And you're back out on the street
[01:00.51] and you're tryin' to remember.
[01:07.12] How do you start it over?
[01:10.95] You don't know if you can.
[01:15.00] You don't care much for a stranger's touch
[01:18.72] but you can't hold your man.
[01:24.28] You never thought you'd be alone
[01:28.43] this far down the line

[01:38.64] you're afraid it's all been wasted time.
[01:49.03] The autumn leaves have got you thinking
[01:57.30] about the first time that you fell.
[02:05.26] You didn't love the boy too much,
[02:09.67] no no, you just loved the boy too well,
[02:18.57] well, well, well.
[02:21.81] So you live from day to day
[02:29.97] and you dream about tomorrow.
[02:36.18] And the hours go by like minutes
[02:40.17] and the shadows come to stay.
[02:44.20] So ya take a little something to make them go away.
